title: The weather report, but for a factory floor's mood
summary: Today's floor forecast: a high-pressure front of overtime moving in from the east, with scattered grumbling clearing by second break.

blocks.title: Mostly productive, turning fractious by mid-afternoon
blocks.body: Good morning, floor. Here is what the atmosphere is doing today, measured in the only units that matter: coffee levels, radio volume, and the number of times someone says 'per the drawing.'

items.title: Low morale fog at the doors
items.detail: Burning off by first break as the coffee pot cycles for the third time. Visibility poor around the punch clock.

items.title: A productive high settles in
items.detail: Clear skies over the machining cell. The good carbide was found. Expect steady chip-making with light banter from the northwest corner.

items.title: A front of hot orders arrives
items.detail: The front office descends with a job that was due yesterday. Gusts of walking-fast-with-papers. The schedule board will not survive unchanged.

items.title: Scattered grumbling, locally dense
items.detail: Concentrated around the machine whose probe batteries chose today to die. A 40% chance of a maintenance ticket, upgraded to 100% by 3.

items.title: Clearing rapidly
items.detail: Overtime was not called. The exit lane sees its daily rush-hour congestion. Tonight: calm, with a slight chance of someone coming in early tomorrow to finish the hot job anyway.

blocks.heading: Extended outlook
rows: Steel-toed patience recommended; counts drift by afternoon
Morale rising sharply, productivity dipping in inverse proportion
Expect the first-hour ritual of remembering where everything was

blocks.title: The almanac says
blocks.body: On this date in floor history: the forklift was found in the far lot with no driver and no explanation. It remains the warmest cold case on record.
